integrity: Exact finite-sample variance and logarithmic asymptotic proved analytically; the included script supplies supporting finite checks only. No external independent validation.
limitations: Only two independent Haar starting points for an integer expanding circle endomorphism with fixed critical window; no CLT, noninteger slopes, or absolute-distance interval claim. Literature priority beyond inspected material is not established.
title: A logarithmic finite-sample correction for two-orbit pair correlations of expanding circle maps
